reviews.text: Dustin built our pool in 2020 and was very responsive and communicated throughout the process. We have been pool owners now 4 years this summer and he’s always helped us whenever we have a question. Quick to still return calls or text even after 4 years! Recommend to everyone
reviews.author: Stephanie Simmons

reviews.text: Dustin and his team were very professional and great with communication throughout the entire process. They were much faster than expected aside from small weather delays and the end product was exactly what we asked for. I will be recommending Lemaster to anyone looking for a pool in the area moving forward.
reviews.author: Keith Sparkman

reviews.text:
Could be happier!!
These guys have gone above and beyond with helping me since I purchased a Pool from them three years ago. Everything I called about and every little issue I had, they were extremely quick to jump on it and take care of it for me within a few hours. They’ve never asked me for any money and have always answered the phone whenever I called. I’ve already recommended them to two people, and one of them has had a Pool installed by them, they also couldn’t be happier.
reviews.author: Joe Donovan

reviews.text: I would highly recommend Lemaster Custom Pools. I had my pool built with them last fall. I didn't leave a review at the time because that is typically not my style. However, they have been to my place three times, once due to an issue with the ice storm, another contractor hitting my pool line, and another due to wear and tear. I can tell you that my entire experience with this company has been positive. The owner Dustin is professional and highly knowledgeable in his field. The lead man Eugene is about the nicest guy you will ever meet, and the field service tech Cody is a great guy who is super personable. If you are looking for a company that will build a beautiful pool and provides you with excellent customer service, this team is the way to go! They always answer my calls and texts and get to my place super fast, knowing that time is money when it comes to pools. Dustin and his crew genuinely hold the customer's interest close to their hearts. I cannot say enough positive things! I am sure any pool company can build you a beautiful pool, but not all of them will have the customer service this group of guys does.
reviews.author: Jessica David

reviews.text:
Dustin was amazing from start to finish! He is organized, knowledgeable, and very good about answering texts and calls quickly.  The customer service provided by all employees was excellent! All the crews who worked on the various phases of construction were outstanding! Our pool is beautiful and well constructed. We would highly recommend Lemaster Custom Pools!
David and Carol Long
reviews.author: Carol Long

reviews.text: Super convenient to have a supply store here in godley. Nice folks a bunch of pool supplies, and they do water testing
reviews.author: Charity Langford

reviews.text:
When the decision was made to build a pool, I wanted quotes from 5 different builders.  I wasn't looking for the cheapest pool, I wanted to go with who I felt was going to do the job right, the first time.  My conclusion: Dustin Lemaster and Lemaster Custom Pools.

First, of all 5 companies, Dustin was the owner I met with, all others were sales guys.  I knew whatever he said, it was on him, his word and his name on the pool.  Second, though his company was only a few years old, it didn't show.  Dustin's experience from working in the pool industry for quite some time and knowledge was outstanding to say the least.   He was confident in his process, didn't try to over sell, but instead built a pool that was exactly what I wanted, to perfection.

Dustin never overpromised anything, just ensured me that there was a process and to trust it, which I did.  Every crew that came out during the process was top notch, professional, organized and did a great job, every step.  His team: Gene, Hayden and Cody were prompt, informative and most importantly continued to pay attention to every detail.  Communication was on point, always in reasonable timing with the mindset of making sure I always knew what was going on and that they were doing everything in their control to go beyond my expectations.

I will finish with this:  If I were to ever build another pool, I would only call Dustin Lemaster and Lemaster Custom Pools.
reviews.author: Michael Pierson

reviews.text: Dustin is an incredible guy to work with. He takes his time to listen to what you want. He responds very quickly to calls or texts. He cares about every step of the process. He isn’t a pushy salesman. Would highly recommend. I can only say great things about our experience with Lemaster Custom Pools
reviews.author: Kristen Green

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with strong signals of genuine customer satisfaction. The limited review count is a minor concern but content is detailed and credible. The company demonstrates excellent post-sale support and owner involvement.
fake_signals: Limited review volume (22 Google, 28 Yelp) for a 5-year-old company
All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (owner name Dustin, crew member Eugene, project timelines)
Mention of post-installation support and long-term responsiveness
Varied writing styles and specific scenarios (ice storm damage, other contractor hitting line)
Emotionally authentic praise mixed with mentions of minor delays
BBB accreditation and A+ rating suggest legitimate business practices
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google (4.6) and Yelp (4.8). BBB A+ rating with accreditation indicates good complaint handling. No contradictory low ratings found.
